layers.name: sheen-sweep

layers.name: cta-chime

layers.name: lowpass-tail
layers.sfx_prompt: Lowpass tail at 400 Hz closing the clip: the whole bed filtered down, 700 ms fade to silence, no new transient, loop-ready into the opening hum.

audio_blueprint.mix_notes: Sum all layers with amix normalize=0 so nothing ducks the narration. Voice sits at 0 dB, SFX at the per-layer gain_db above, master limited to -0.5 dBFS.
